story.body: You told Field the two entries are not yours to print. You named a duke, four lovers, and a weaver instead of a poem. You said you would come on Sunday. You would not give the second volume back on the grounds that one king has been played.

title: Refused a third poem and kept the second volume

participation.context: Said the poem is not there, and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You said you have not got a third poem, and that the work in hand is not a book for an idle Friday. You did not give the volume back. You stopped.
